_doc: The evidence workbook (J4検証資料(...)_<Excel_NAME>.xlsx), read off the delivered sample (QJDSWM39): sheet names, labels, font, highlight patterns, and where the DF / Jenkins boxes go.

evidence._homeCell_doc: excel.tidy leaves every sheet scrolled to the top with homeCell selected; a sheet whose name starts with a homeCellFor key gets that cell instead (2026-10-12: A3, the 送信⇒ / 受信⇒ sheets A1).
evidence._saveDialogs_doc: the office PC's document-classification add-in opens 文書分類/機密区分の登録 on every save and the run waits; excel.tidy answers a window whose title contains one of these with Esc (the operator's own answer). [] to answer it by hand.
evidence._logMinRow_doc: the GFIX受信ログ label never starts above this row: the Excel snap copied to B3 is sometimes a row shorter (10/14 CJODWDB6 / FJODWDB6 ended at row 6, label on row 7); the template's place is row 8.

list._doc: picture 1 (the Excel snap) is taken from the real overview workbook paths.gfixList (10/16, the old ExcelSnap.ps1 way): AutoFilter 送信 / ジョブ = the J name, snap from 'left' to 'job'; when two or more rows are the same from 'left' to 'job' the snap runs on to 'extendTo' (加瀬さん 10/13 review of JJDSWM10, rows 326/327; ニンヌ's fix in JJDSWM51). Columns are found by these labels in groupRow / subRow; a sub label matches a cell that starts with it.
list._sheet_doc: the workbook has both GFIX送受信一覧 and GFIX送受信一覧(BIX); the BIX one is the source (operator, 10/16)

GFIX受信ログ from row 8, label bold; yellow rows on the Command / uploaded lines
GFIXReceive.log block: yellow on fileName / file stored
Jenkins picture: red box on this job's file

evidence._checklist_doc: the evidence GATE's 'check:' lines (10/15). Add a point when a review finds something the gate did not ask about; docs/ebi-dance/KNOWLEDGE.md says how a point grows into an automatic check.
evidence._glob_doc: starts with J4 so the ~$ lock file Excel leaves next to an open workbook never matches

checkSheet._doc: gfixRecv.deliver (10/15): the review check sheet row, read off Check Sheet_J4 (row 351..358: B 記入日 / C COBOL/JAVA / E 確認ﾌｪｰｽﾞ / F レビュー対象 = the evidence book's file name / G 担当 / H 確認). The columns are in the workflow (excel.append_row cells); the values that may change are here.
checklistRows: Excel is in front: one new row per job at the bottom -- B date, C JAVA, E J4内部ﾚﾋﾞｭｰ, F the evidence book, G owner, H reviewer
Enter = every row is right: the sheet is saved and closed, then one review-mail draft per job opens (s / n = not now: nothing saved, the jobs stay pending)
checklistSent: every draft is in front: To, the job name in the subject, the file name in the body

send them all in Outlook, then Enter here: every job's deliver = ok (s = later: the sheet rows are saved, deliver stays pending; send the drafts from Drafts, then run deliver again -- it finds the rows and marks the jobs ok without new drafts)
checkSheet._checklist_doc: 10/19: deliver writes every row first, ONE check (checklistRows), then every draft, ONE check (checklistSent). A book already on the check sheet (listed by hand, e.g. R/S on 10/14) is taken as requested: no row, no draft, deliver = ok

df._doc: DF captures (leader, 2026-10-12): one picture shows 16 data lines (window 1133 x 429, the sample evidence). <= 16 lines: one picture; 17..32: a second picture after PgDn from the top, so it starts at line 17 (keysMid: Ctrl+Home, PgDn); more: the END view (keysEnd: End, PgUp, Down, Down -- the operator 10/20, checked on SJODWSPN 61 lines: the END picture starts at 00045 and ends at 00061; 10/19 had tried ONE Down, which started one line early). Wave between the two. Boxes on the second (or only) picture: the last line number (last band of dark ink in the line-number strip) and the 同一内容 cell of the status bar (bottom-right). Some workbooks follow the HOST team's 19-line pictures instead: check by hand until that case is detected (see TODO).
df._size_doc: 10/19 (review NG on SJODWDB6, B35; measured on the operator's own fix): DF draws 18 px per line, and a 1133 x 476 window shows 17 lines -- 429 showed only 15 (00112-00126), not the 16 the 10/12 note assumed. The HOST screen shows 17 records and HOST line n = DF line n-1 (HOST counts a first line the CSV does not have), so: the first picture (HOST 000001-000017) = DF 1-16 -> height 458 (= 476 - 18, derived, not yet seen); the END picture (HOST last 17) = DF last 17 -> heightEnd 476 (measured). Pictures whose HOST range is not one of these (e.g. 19-line HOST shots) are still matched by hand: docs/TODO.md.
df._fit_doc: 10/21 MEASURED (operator's sweep, 1133 wide, 2 px steps, MJODWDBC): DF lines are 18 px apart, digits 13 px tall. FIRST view (Ctrl+Home): 436-444 = 16 lines + the top of the 17th, 446-452 = 17, 454-462 = 17 + the 18th, 464+ = 18 -> 16 clean lines only at about 430-434, so height 432. 458 showed 17 lines + 6 px of the 18th: that was the 10/20 upper picture 加瀬さん sent back. END view (End, PgUp, Down, Down): always one line fewer than the window holds, the row under the last line stays blank -- 436-444 = 15, 446-462 = 16, 464-480 = 17 -> heightEnd 476 is right; 476 - 18 was never the first height. The track step also fits each capture (screen.launch_capture fitStrip: counts the text bands in marks[0].lastInk and resizes until exactly 16 / linesEnd whole lines show, nothing of the next), so these heights are where the fit starts.

marks._doc: the 同一内容 cell of the status bar, from the bottom-right corner. 10/21 KJODWWBV: x 117 / w 112 also covered the right part of 移動 (the right edges met) -> x 94 / w 91, measured on the operator's screenshot (rough: set it in ebi.local.json layout.df.marks if it is still off)

share._doc: how human.share puts the Teams reply on the clipboard: rich = text + pictures in ONE paste (HTML + RTF); sequence = text, then each picture, one paste each. Switch in <WorkDir>/ebi.local.json { "layout": { "share": { "mode": "sequence" } } } if Teams drops the pictures of a rich paste.
share._front_doc: 10/19: once the reply is on the clipboard the Teams window comes to the front (regex on process name or title; new Teams = ms-teams, classic = Teams). Empty = the console stays in front.
